اجتحت (form VIII)
# اِجْتَحْتُ (ijtaḥtu) /id͡ʒ.taħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِجْتَاحَ (ijtāḥa)
# اِجْتَحْتَ (ijtaḥta) /id͡ʒ.taħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِجْتَاحَ (ijtāḥa)
# اِجْتَحْتِ (ijtaḥti) /id͡ʒ.taħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِجْتَاحَ (ijtāḥa)
# اُجْتِحْتُ (ujtiḥtu) /ud͡ʒ.tiħ.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِج
